title: Cable Lateral Raise
summary: A one-arm cable side raise that keeps the side delt loaded at the bottom, where dumbbells go slack.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: cable station with an adjustable pulley.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for side delts (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly side delts total.
Library rating 0.3 for traps (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly traps total.

setup.text: Set the pulley low and stand side-on to it, holding the handle with your far hand.
Let the cable pull your hand across your body slightly.
Raise your arm out to the side to about shoulder height.
Lower slowly back across your body.

form_cues.cue: Raise the arm out to the side
Keep a slight bend in the elbow
Standing a little in front of the pulley gives a longer stretch.

mistakes.text: Shrugging the trap up as the hand rises.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less isolation, Less stable, Both sides together.

notes: Ratings, swap attributes and cues are the library model (modeled). An authored page will replace this one.
